'''ArrGack''' was the [[Chief Tax Chaplain]] of the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He and his underling, [[GrrKack]], were bribed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] shuttle ''[[Bonderium]]'' for entrance into the Paradise Sector. [[L9-G8]], head chef of ''Bonderium'', instructed ''Bonderium's'' crew on how to make an Ugorian feast, which included: [[single-celery soda]], [[spirogyra gelatin]], [[glazed glucose pate]], [[free-floating fungal fondu]], [[mitochondria crunchy surprise]], and [[photo-lipids in brazened fatty-acid sauce]].
